metadata.name: Snowline Offices
metadata.author: Tile Trigger
metadata.description: An office block on a snowy night. Tide hold the hostages at the back (the conference room, the server room and an office off the middle); Embers come in from the front lot through the lobby, by the side doors off the snowy alleys, or round through the parking garage and its wide door. Corridors front and back, glass walls, and a maze of offices between.
